## Cat Key 1.5.0: the Cat Dock

**⬇ [Download for Windows](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-Setup-x64.exe)** or the [portable exe](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-portable-x64.exe) · **[Download for Mac](https://github.com/MasterfullyClaw/CatKey/releases/latest/download/CatKey-mac.dmg)** (Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 11+).

### Your cat on the edge of the screen
Turn it on with the new cat-ball button at the top of Cat Key (or Settings → Cat Dock). The cat peeks out from the edge of your screen; drag it anywhere along either side, click it to open its little panel. It wears the cat you picked.

- **🥣 Food bowl:** drop files, text or links on the cat (it reaches out and catches them). Drag them back out into any folder or app to copy them; copy, open or show them in their folder with one click. Type quick notes too.
- **📦 Litter box:** files here *move* when you drag them out, instead of copying. Send things from the bowl with one click.
- **🧶 Copied:** everything you copy, searchable, with pins. Click one to copy it again. It stays on your computer, only until Cat Key closes unless you choose otherwise, and what password managers copy is never kept.
- **⏰ Focus:** 15, 25, 45 or 60 minutes (or your own). A ring runs round the cat ball, and when it ends your cat walks across the bottom of the screen to tell you. Clicks go straight through it.
- **🐾 PC:** processor, memory, graphics (Windows) and heat (Mac), read every 2 seconds with the system's own counters. When your computer works hard, the cat gets serious; when it's hot, it sweats.
- **The purr player** sits at the top of the panel: play, stop and volume.
- Out of the way: the cat hides while a game or a film fills the screen.

### Also
- **About** has the website link now.
- **Sounds:** a new switch for the Cat Dock's sounds.
- Each release starts on a real Windows machine and a real Mac with the Dock on before it's published.

**Mac, first open:** Cat Key isn't notarized by Apple yet. Open it once, then System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**. If that goes round in circles, paste this into Terminal: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Cat Key.app" && open "/Applications/Cat Key.app"`.
